data.narrative:
Ocius Technology is a Series B defense and security company founded by Robert Dane. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers across the same sector and stage—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Castelion, and Defense Unicorns.

The peer-median method was applied across 7 same-sector, same-stage comparables, yielding a median valuation of $1.0B. The peer universe ranges from $300M to $3.0B, with the median anchored by firms such as Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), and Castelion and Defense Unicorns (both $1.0B). This method provides the primary triangulation point given the limited availability of alternative valuation data for early-stage defense technology.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $850M to $1.1B, centered on $1.0B. The company's A$176M Australian Program of Record contract (secured March 2026) provides revenue underpinning, though the timing and scale of contract execution remain key uncertainties. The narrow range reflects reliance on a single method; widening the analysis would require additional revenue or profitability data and greater visibility into contract drawdown schedules. Peer comparability also carries execution risk, given heterogeneity in defense subsector exposure and customer concentration across the comp set.
